entities.name: Lighthouse Island
entities.description: Elongated mountainous island off Stonehaven in western Corondor, once guiding ships to Arathoxia.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Land on Dominaria protected by the island.

entities.name: Arathoxia
entities.description: Formerly proud port city, now mostly abandoned and in ruin.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Sent warships and took control of the Stonehaven islands after the Fall of Arathoxia.

events.summary: After the Fall of Arathoxia in 4195 AR, Ravidel sends warships and takes control of the Stonehaven islands, including Lighthouse Island.
events.quote: Ravidel sent warships out and took control of the islands of Stonehaven
